newsitem.title: SPAIN: IBCA details reasons behind BCH upgrade.
newsitem.headline: IBCA details reasons behind BCH upgrade.

text.p: IBCA said on Wednesday it had upgraded its individual rating on Spain's Banco Central Hispano because of improved asset quality and profitability.
"(A 1995) restructuring plan has cleaned up BCH's balance sheet and has led to improved asset quality and a reduction in the amount of low-yielding assets held.
"Profitability, while lower than that of other major Spanish banking groups, has improved," IBCA said in a statement.
Earlier on Wednesday, IBCA upgraded its individual rating on BCH to "B/C" from "C".
